name: usb-touch-egalax
description: Pi 4 bare-metal USB host: PCIe root complex + VL805 xHCI + VL805 internal USB 2.0 hub + eGalax (0eef:0005) full-speed HID touch on a hub port. Fills api->svc->touch with panel-pixel coordinates.

hardware.panel: Waveshare 7" HDMI LCD 1024x600, capacitive USB touch
hardware.cabling: touch USB must go into a USB-A jack (all four are behind the VL805 hub); the USB-C port is a different controller (DWC2) and is not served here

registers.xhci_mmio_cpu: 0x600000000 (outbound window → PCIe 0xF8000000 = VL805 BAR0); reading it before link-up hangs the CPU
registers.dma_region: 0x02200000-0x0222FFFF identity-mapped: DCBAA 0x02200000, cmd ring 0x02201000, event ring 0x02202000, ERST 0x02203000, hub ctx/ring 0x02204000-0x02207000, spad array 0x02208000, dev ctx/ring 0x02209000-0x0220C000, intr ring 0x0220D000, reports 0x0220E000, spad buffers 0x02210000+
registers.mailbox_vl805_firmware: tag 0x00030058 arg 0x00100000 — only succeeds after secondary bus / BAR / window setup

lessons: single-TT hub: child slot context TT Port Number must be 0 (only multi-TT hubs use the real port) — else Address Device returns Parameter Error (17)
hub slot must be marked with Hub bit / NbrPorts / TTT via Configure Endpoint before addressing a child
learn EP0 max packet size from the first 8 descriptor bytes and apply it with Evaluate Context (this device: 64 despite full speed)
~50 ms settle after Address Device on this full-speed device or the first control transfer fails
never SET_IDLE: the device STALLs, EP0 halts and the single TT wedges (interrupt split error 36)
event ring is 16 entries: wrap the dequeue index, toggle the cycle state, and keep ERDP advancing
EXEC probes over ~1460 bytes must use chunked upload (EXLD) — the sender's IP fragments are not reassembled
